tokens.noTokensHint: Create a new API key to open tunnels, add domains and query status via the Zorven REST API.
tokens.ipHowTitle: How Does Ingress IP Filtering Work?
tokens.ipHowBody: By default your tunnels are public. But when you add at least 1 active IP rule for a specific tunnel or your whole organization, all HTTP/HTTPS requests to that target are checked. Any client outside the allowed CIDR blocks is immediately blocked with 403 Forbidden (ip_forbidden).
tokens.noRulesHint: When no rules are defined, your tunnels are reachable from the entire internet. Add a rule to allow access only from specific IPs or office networks.
tokens.tokenNamePlaceholder: e.g. GitHub Actions CI/CD, Staging Kubernetes
tokens.issuedWarn: Warning: This key is shown only once for cryptographic reasons. For your security, copy the key immediately and store it in a secret vault (secret manager, .env). Once this window is closed, the key cannot be displayed again!
tokens.ipCidrHint: When you enter a single IP address, /32 (or /128 for IPv6) is added automatically.
tokens.descPlaceholder: e.g. Company VPN Exit, Izmir Office Static IP
tokens.upgradeMsg: Programmatic REST API Keys and Ingress IP Filtering are available on the Pro, Team and Enterprise plans. Please upgrade your plan.
